G_R_reactivation_precondition.subset_note: union returns are a subset of true-absence candidates by frozen definition, so a G-R pass establishes >= 36 absence windows on writing_2's unscreened half - REACTIVATE's absence-window precondition needs no separate floor
G_R_reactivation_precondition.shrinkage_disclosure: selection shrinkage is NEGLIGIBLE by order statistics (runner-up eligible rate 9; P(rate-9 >= 36) ~ 1e-11): top-of-pool selection cannot have inflated writing_2's 50. The honest risk is the VARIANCE MODEL: returns are burst-clustered events from one or two identities; under overdispersion var = phi*mean, P(unscreened >= 36 | rate 50) falls from the Poisson idealization 0.98 to ~0.94 (phi=2) and ~0.85 (phi=4); no half-to-half model is trusted; the gate exists to catch phase confinement. Genuinely failable
G_R_reactivation_precondition.one_scene_inference: the scene-level cluster bootstrap is degenerate for a one-scene claim; reactivation-arm inference in M2 uses a TEMPORAL-BLOCK bootstrap within writing_2 (blocks of consecutive events; exchangeability caveat disclosed); the gate artifact publishes the per-identity decomposition of writing_2's returns
